name: Sudan
who: Army (SAF) vs the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces
what: Civil war hardening into a formal partition

how: RSF controls Darfur and the west; army holds the center, north and east
current: The war in Sudan has killed at least 59,000 people, displaced about 13 million, and pushed parts of the country into famine. The conflict between the Sudanese army and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) has created one of the world's worst humanitarian crises. Aid organizations have warned that funding cuts are worsening the hunger crisis, with the World Food Programme's new Executive Director stating that aid is the 'only hope' for millions in Sudan.

Meanwhile, the African Development Bank and the International Committee of the Red Cross have signed a three‑year action plan to support conflict‑affected communities in the Sahel, according to regional reports.
